XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Device: Steering actuator

  • Fault: The message “Adaptive steering fault – Repair” appears on the instrument panel with the steering fault warning light illuminated. The steering wheel operates normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0130 (CAN data bus, steering effort sensor – Loss of communication)

  • Cause: Steering actuator fault

• Action: Check that the steering actuator is working correctly and, if necessary, replace the steering assembly including the actuator.
